scope_limits: No new PhysX cooking, contact, wheel-leg dynamics, flight, landing, or training validation.
ZIP itself declares source-geometry-only coverage, not a certified robot training task.
External source README reports42 representative CPU PhysX probes; this cannot establish all terrain or robot dynamics and was not rerun.
No source USD semantic terrain/tier labels, spawn routes, launch/landing zones, requests, phases, reward, or task contract are authored.
Floor beneath the gap remains present. A landing-position-only success condition would permit a floor detour; require measured airborne crossing and stabilization.
Irregular top polygons and neighboring side/guard colliders need route footprint/clearance validation.
V2.0.0 CAD source is not itself proof of latest V2.2.0 rule compliance; parent audited current rules separately.
